name: expiry_seller_v2
kind: forward paper test (no orders): every trade is decided by the rules below before its outcome exists
question: does the far-wing condor that expiry_wings_v1 selected (BANKNIFTY, short 0.20 / long 0.05 delta) survive the real bid/ask at the minute it would be traded, and stay consistent with its history. It is the crash-insured version of the strangle: on 7.7 years of real prices it kept 60% of the strangle's mean and cut its worst trade from -Rs 50,684 to -Rs 20,891 per lot

history.source: expiry_wings_v1 (spec 03ed351842ac), Study run 37162998404: docs/prereg/results/expiry_wings_v1-03ed351842ac.md; NSE F&O bhavcopy 2019-01 to 2026-09, evidence class real_eod_approximation
history.convention: the same as expiry_seller_v1: entry at the close one session before expiry, legs at close -/+ (0.05 + max(0.05, 0.2% of the price)), statutory fees, held to the expiry-day close, STT 0.125% on exercised long legs
history.caveats: 43 configurations tried across the two studies; selected among 3 wing distances by a rule fixed before the run; BANKNIFTY expiries are monthly since Nov 2024, so about 12 forward trades a year

C.risk: defined: max loss = wider wing - credit

size: 1 lot; P&L reported in rupees per lot
entry: exactly as expiry_seller_v1 (the tape snapshot nearest 15:20 within 15:10-15:25 on the eve, real quotes only, out-of-the-money strikes with |delta| nearest the target within 0.08, a two-sided quote on every leg, sells at bid - 0.05, buys at ask + 0.05, statutory fees)
exit: exactly as expiry_seller_v1 (cash settlement at the mean of the recorded 15:00-15:29 index closes, Yahoo's close as the fallback, STT on exercised long legs)
measured_per_trade: as expiry_seller_v1: P&L, the cost gap against the history's convention at the same snapshot, max loss, margin (its max loss)
rules: as expiry_seller_v1: the cost check from 6 settled trades, the consistency check from 8, a loss beyond the max loss is a bug, a retired sleeve opens nothing more

eligibility.paper_account: reported, never applied automatically: eligible for the Rs 5,00,000 paper account with at least 10 settled forward trades, the cost check passed and consistency not rejected

changes: any change to these rules is a new spec with its own ledger; this ledger is never edited
